oracle.selection_rule: Accepted documented behavior is normative; incidental formatting and known implementation quirks are not.

compatibility.breaking_change: new major contract and an explicit migration path

cli.machine_output: JSON on stdout when --json is supported; diagnostics on stderr; non-zero on failure

requirements.rule: A canonical record becomes visible in full or remains at its previous full value; temporary and partial-write residue is never treated as a record.
For concurrent claims of one eligible ticket, exactly one claimant succeeds and all losers receive a stable conflict without corrupting the ticket.
A ticket with any unfinished dependency cannot be claimed; cycles and missing dependencies are rejected before mutation.
An active objective has a measurable exit criterion and reaches a terminal state only with evidence or a recorded blocked/replaced reason.
Messages are immutable, project-scoped records with a bound author. Direct recipients and exact @mentions receive delivery; code spans, email addresses and @@ text do not create mentions.
An explicit task delivery is actionable until its recipient acknowledges it. Delivery alone is not execution, and ordinary conversation does not start work.
Delivery is at-least-once. Replaying the same request is idempotent, and (message_id, recipient_agent_id) creates at most one wake job and one active run.
Every installed harness owns a durable agent identity. A baked identity and board path override ambient shell values for hook and wrapper execution.
Hook installation and rollback are atomic and idempotent. Rollback restores exact prior bytes and refuses to erase post-install edits.
One live lease exists per project and agent. Takeover after expiry increments a fencing epoch; a stale runner cannot heartbeat, expire or mutate through its old epoch.
Backup is a consistent snapshot. Restore verifies before replace, removes stale sidecars, keeps the replaced copy, and never revives post-snapshot writes.
Board, worktree, hook and knowledge operations resolve paths before access and refuse a symlink or traversal that escapes the declared root.
Lease decisions use explicit comparable UTC instants and fencing epochs. Knowledge timestamps more than five minutes in the future are rejected.
Knowledge is separate from ticket state. References are exact knowledge:<node-id> tokens, edges cannot masquerade as nodes, and prompt selection is bounded and provenance-preserving.
Documented --json commands emit one valid JSON value on stdout with no prose. Errors exit non-zero, identify the failed subject or stable error code, and do not emit a success value.
The core reads the frozen Python file-board fixture without changing it. Migrations preserve archived unknown data and are atomic.
After warmup, a 250-ticket local board summary has p95 under 1000 ms on the reference laptop; correctness gates remain mandatory at every size.
